limitations: No pixel-error threshold is relaxed. Missing/invisible original points remain failures; RMS with missing points must not be presented as an aggregate acceptance score.
G and 665 are previous training/regression views, not independent holdouts.
New semantic groups are declared construction evidence, constrained by actual H silhouette orientation; they are not independent source observations.
No person/foreground occluder is synthesized, and source cuts are never extended. Full-scene visibility treats opaque evaluated mesh geometry, not alpha/transmission.
Numerical BVH + double-precision triangle tests are not exact rational certification. Adjoining triangles sharing a mesh vertex are excluded from nonadjacent intersection checks.
Contact intersections demonstrate overlap between separate objects, not mechanical joining or physically plausible hidden completion.
White-copy invariance and native render appearance are separate parent checks.

fixed_ownership_ledger.C23: First six original observations, y=906..1020: panel. Last two, y=1048 and 1070: left support.
fixed_ownership_ledger.C25_v2b: All eight original observations: continuous left frame/support object.

fixed_composite_return.method: Predeclared fixed construction ownership, followed by directed outer (leftmost x) boundary at each original source y and full-scene visibility probes. No per-point nearest-object or best-any-object choice. Existing per-object diagnostics are retained unchanged.
fixed_composite_return.interpretation: Conditional whole-chair composite-return comparison across changed construction. The image does not independently establish the panel/frame split; ownership is explicitly declared, not inferred by minimizing error.

white_material_invariance.scope: Exact saved-state comparison of all object raw geometry, topology, matrices/transforms, cameras, visibility, collections, world, scene render/color settings, modifiers and constraints as serialized by verify_geometry.py. Only the intentionally replaced material datablocks, mesh material slots, and face material indices are exempted.
